verdict.rationale: Interface stability and deprecation policy are a fair question for a package manager and CLI tool like Nix, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a version-numbered manual path (2.28) for the CLI and package-version rollback, which concerns software packages rather than API versioning. Nothing documents versioned APIs or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
